result.description:
A thriving, established medical practice is seeking a dedicated  General Practitioner  to join its dynamic team. This opportunity arises from an existing and expanding patient base, with a particular need for a  full-time GP  and a GP with a  special interest in allergies . The practice is a busy,  private billing  centre, utilizing intelligent practice analytics (like Cubiko) to offer insights that support individual billing choices. 

 The centre is a modern, purpose-built facility boasting industry-leading equipment and conveniently located in a vibrant area. The practice ensures robust clinical autonomy for its GPs within a supportive work environment that champions workplace diversity and inclusion. The team composition includes dedicated nursing support for treatment room procedures and Chronic Disease Management (CDM) care, alongside experienced administrative teams to manage non-clinical tasks efficiently. Allied health services are available on-site, including CDM clinics, pathology services, and specialists in dietetics and psychology, fostering a truly collaborative environment. 

 Exceptional opportunities for professional growth are provided. The practice offers flexible working arrangements to support work-life balance. GPs receive comprehensive CPD support, including a partnership that simplifies meeting RACGP requirements, free in-house CPD events, and discounted registration for industry conferences. Supervisor opportunities for GP Registrars are available with expanded support. The practice actively encourages and supports the pursuit of special interests in areas such as skin cancer, aesthetics, occupational medicine, and, specifically, allergies. The allergy clinic is a significant service, and a GP with membership in the Australian Society for Clinical Immunology and Allergy (ASCIA) is highly desired to perform individual assessments, including skin prick testing and lung function testing. 

 The location is classified as a  DPA approved  location, making it attractive for doctors on the FSP, PEP, and other 3GA programs seeking to fulfil Fellowship pathway requirements. Beyond the professional benefits, the setting offers appealing lifestyle benefits, given its proximity to major amenities and tertiary education. The practice is established, ensures a high patient flow, and is part of a larger network that provides sophisticated IT, marketing, and finance services.   Apply Now
